name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Day-old rice fried with egg, peas and green onion.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok until shimmering.
Scramble the eggs until just set and push them aside.
Add the rice and peas and stir-fry until the rice is hot and slightly crisp.
Season with soy sauce, fold in the egg and sliced green onion, and serve.
